name: blr-lakes-vo-1
text: This is Bengaluru's main bus station. [short pause] It used to be a lake. Majestic... opened in nineteen sixty-nine... on the bed of Dharmambudhi lake. Old Bengaluru lived on lakes. Kere, in Kannada. They held the rain for the whole city. In nineteen sixty-one... the city had close to two hundred and sixty-one lakes. Then the city needed land. Sampangi lake? A stadium. Challaghatta? A golf course. Koramangala lake? A housing layout. And here's the number that shocks people. [pause] Between nineteen seventy-three and two thousand seven... the city's lake area fell by about sixty-one percent. But water remembers where it used to live. When lakes and their channels are built over... the rain has nowhere to go. That's one big reason experts link Bengaluru's floods to its lost lakes. So... would you buy a home on an old lake bed?
